### God Can Restore Your Lost Years
Author: Colin Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/god-can-restor-your-lost-years/
Passage: Joel 2:25
Points:
- Although lost time cannot be regained through human means, God promises to restore barren and wasted years.
- Locust seasons take many forms, including fruitless labor, grief, personal rebellion, and misdirected pursuits.
- God restores lost years by deepening the believer's intimate fellowship and communion with Christ.
- He can compensate for past fruitlessness by multiplying future spiritual harvest and kingdom impact.
- Short-term losses yield long-term gains as tested faith ultimately brings glory and honor to the Savior.

### God Longs to Restore You - The Crosswalk Devotional - July 29
Author: Jessica Van Roekel
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/god-longs-to-restore-you-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Joel 2:25-27
Points:
- Unexpected hardships and painful seasons can strip life bare like a sudden swarm of locusts.
- In times of devastation, believers face the choice to draw near to God rather than pull away.
- A thriving relationship with the Lord is anchored in His enduring faithfulness, not comfortable circumstances.
- Resting in God's ultimate promise of restoration and eternity reframes our present grief and trouble.
- Just as fruitful growth emerges from buried seeds, God brings renewal and spiritual flourishing from barren ground.
